# Bangalore Urban Cabs

> 24/7 taxi service in Bengaluru, India: fixed-price tour packages, Kempegowda
> Airport transfers, outstation cabs (one-way & round trip), hourly rentals,
> corporate travel and acting drivers. No surge pricing, no advance payment —
> book on WhatsApp or by phone at +91 70227 62929.

Prices are published on every page and include fuel and driver allowance.
Day-trip tour packages also include tolls and parking; on outstation and
multi-day trips tolls, parking and inter-state permits are at actuals. Sedan, SUV,
Innova Crysta and 12+1 Tempo Traveller classes are available.

## Key pages

- [Tour packages from Bangalore](https://bangaloreurbancabs.com/tour-packages/): 19 fixed-price cab tours — Mysore 1-day ₹5,800, Coorg 2-day ₹8,600, Nandi Hills + Adiyogi, Lepakshi, Ooty, Tirupati, Kodaikanal, Hampi and more, each with a full day-by-day itinerary.
- [Bangalore airport taxi](https://bangaloreurbancabs.com/airport-taxi-bangalore/): flat fares from ₹899 (≤40 km), flight tracking, area-wise pages for Whitefield, Electronic City, Koramangala, HSR Layout, Indiranagar, Yelahanka.
- [Outstation cabs](https://bangaloreurbancabs.com/outstation-cabs-bangalore/): 21 route pages with one-way and round-trip fares (e.g. Bangalore to Mysore ₹2,799 one-way).
- [One-way drop taxi](https://bangaloreurbancabs.com/one-way-cab-bangalore/): pay one side only — sedan ₹18/km with fixed drop fares to 15+ cities, both directions.
- [Hourly rental](https://bangaloreurbancabs.com/hourly-cab-rental-bangalore/): 4h/40km from ₹1,200, 8h/80km from ₹2,200.
- [Hire an acting driver](https://bangaloreurbancabs.com/hire-driver-bangalore/): verified drivers for your own car.
- [Book](https://bangaloreurbancabs.com/book/): booking form; most customers book directly on WhatsApp (+91 70227 62929).
- [Travel guides](https://bangaloreurbancabs.com/guides/): 12 driver-written guides — Mysore expressway tips, Nandi Hills sunrise, Ooty via Bandipur, temples near Bangalore, full taxi fare tables, Coorg vs Ooty vs Chikmagalur, KIA pickup walkthrough, Tirupati planning.
- [FAQ](https://bangaloreurbancabs.com/faq/) · [Terms & cancellation](https://bangaloreurbancabs.com/terms/) · [Contact](https://bangaloreurbancabs.com/contact/)

## Business facts

- Service area: Bengaluru city and outstation across South India (Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, Kerala, Andhra Pradesh, Goa).
- Address: RMV 2nd Stage, Bhoopasandra, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560094, India.
- Hours: 24/7, year-round. Languages: English, Kannada, Hindi.
- Payment: cash, UPI, cards — paid after the trip; no advance required.
